name: Majo Hime-sama wa Gohoushi Chuu
source:
Witch girl Cham appears before main character and claims that it's her obligation as a royal princess to fulfill wish of the first person she meets. 

Wow, is that you wish? Alright, I shall do it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
魔女女孩查姆出现在主人公面前，声称作为王室公主，她有义务满足遇见的第一个人的愿望。

“哇，那就是你的愿望？好吧，我会照办。”

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
